releases.name: Open Speech Studio v0.10.3
changes: **Vastloper / crash na langer gebruik opgelost.** Bij het vasthouden van de dicteer-sneltoets kon Windows snelle toets-herhaling-events (losgelaten/ingedrukt-paren) sturen. Elk paar startte een start/stop-cyclus waarbij telkens Whisper draaide, wat de app overspoelde en na verloop van tijd bevroor of liet crashen (soms met een wit scherm). Deze events worden nu weggedebouncet, zodat één keer vasthouden precies één opname is.
**Eind-geluid** bij loslaten van de toets vuurt nu betrouwbaar precies één keer.

releases.name: v0.5.0 — Dictation Overlay, Audio Feedback & Spell Check
changes: Floating popup (bottom-right corner) shows recording status, transcription progress, and estimated time remaining
Audio level bar confirms your microphone is working while recording
Transparent window without borders — clean, minimal design
**Ctrl + Win** and **Ctrl + Shift + Space** both work as hold-to-record
Ctrl+Win uses a low-level Windows keyboard hook to bypass OS interception
Both shortcuts shown across all UI screens
Rising blip when you press the hotkey (recording starts)
Falling blip when you release (recording stops)
Pleasant major chord chime on successful transcription
Low buzz on error
Works in both dictation and meeting recording
Automatic post-transcription spelling correction with built-in word lists (Dutch, English, German, French)
Shows original text (strikethrough) alongside corrected version
Toggle on/off in Settings > Speech
Users can add custom word lists in the config directory
~80 pre-loaded terms for the AEC/BIM industry: IFC, buildingSMART, FreeCAD, ArchiCAD, Speckle, CityGML, NL-SfB, and more
Whisper misrecognitions like "open aec" → "OpenAEC" are automatically corrected
Settings > Speech shows detected GPU name, VRAM, driver version
Recommendation whether GPU acceleration is beneficial for your hardware
Non-WAV audio files (OGG, MP3, M4A, OPUS, MP4, WebM) are automatically converted via ffmpeg
WhatsApp voice messages (.ogg) now fully supported
Auto-transcribe interval: automatically captures segments every 1–30 minutes (default: 5 min)
Overlay popup shows during meeting recording
Model selection synced with the Models page — always in sync
Audio feedback on start/stop/segment capture
Per-model tracking with sensible defaults (tiny: 0.15x, base: 0.25x, small: 0.5x, etc.)
Estimate improves automatically with each transcription
Countdown shown in the overlay during transcription
